title: FedPref: Federated Preference Learning for Structured Radiology Report Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2608.16971v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Radiology reports describe findings and locations in free text, but downstream search and analysis require these relations in a fixed schema. Learning this extraction requires labels that are unevenly distributed across institutions: smaller hospitals have less local evidence, and pooling data may be infeasible. We introduce FedPref: frozen public language models propose alternative JSON extractions, local annotations rank them, and sites collaboratively train compact Qwen3-8B adapters while sharing only model updates. A heterogeneous teacher pool provides cross-model contrast when repeated single-model samples collapse. On development data from six simulated hospitals with unequal data volume and disease prevalence, FedPref improves client-mean F1 by 2.49 points and worst-site F1 by 9.10 points compared with training each site in isolation, with the largest gains at the sites holding the least data. translated_title: FedPref：面向结构化放射学报告提取的联邦偏好学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16971v1 公告类型：新 摘要：放射学报告以自由文本形式描述发现和位置，但下游搜索和分析需要这些关系采用固定模式。学习这种提取需要标签，而这些标签在不同机构间分布不均：较小的医院本地证据较少，而汇总数据可能不可行。我们引入了FedPref：冻结的公共语言模型提出备选的JSON提取，本地注释对其进行排序，各站点协作训练紧凑的Qwen3-8B适配器，仅共享模型更新。异构教师池在重复单模型样本坍缩时提供跨模型对比。在六个模拟医院（数据量和疾病患病率不均）的开发数据上，与每个站点独立训练相比，FedPref将客户端平均F1提高了2.49个百分点，最差站点F1提高了9.10个百分点，其中数据最少的站点获益最大。在汇总偏好数据上的集中训练...
tldr: FedPref通过联邦偏好学习，利用冻结公共语言模型生成候选提取和本地排序，协作训练轻量适配器，显著提升数据稀缺站点的结构化放射学报告提取性能。
en_tdlr: FedPref leverages federated preference learning with frozen public language models for candidate generation and local ranking, collaboratively training lightweight adapters to substantially improve structured radiology report extraction, especially for data-scarce sites.
